artworks.title: Bank Holiday, Corner of Beaufort Street, Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching in green on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 7.6 × 7 cm (3 × 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The artwork depicts a sidewalk with various figures walking. The horizon is not visible, focusing on the bustling scene. The painting features fine and linear brushstrokes giving it a sketch-like appearance. The simple color palette consists of cool blue tones against a light background, creating a light atmosphere. People are walking on the sidewalk, while others are further away, some in conversation. Leafy trees and buildings are depicted on both sides with light and airy strokes, adding an impressionistic quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Emma and Her Baby, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 11.8 × 9.5 cm (4 5/8 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a child in her arms. The woman is facing to the left, and the child is looking towards her. The woman wears a hat with a ribbon, a full dress, and stands in front of a wooden fence. The background shows faint outlines of a landscape or cityscape.

artworks.title: Emma and Her Baby, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 11.8 × 9.5 cm (4 5/8 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a child. The adult is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the child. The person has dark hair partly covered by a hat with a bow. The child is facing the adult. The adult wears a long dress and a wide-brimmed hat, while the child is in a light garment with a hat or bonnet. The background has a tall fence and outlines of buildings or structures, suggesting an outdoor urban or suburban setting.

artworks.title: The Little Fish Shop, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 11.9 × 8 cm (4 11/16 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a storefront with its surrounding exterior. The drawing features a detailed facade of a building, a window display, an adjacent doorway, two windows with flower boxes on the upper level, and a streetlamp standing beside the entrance. The architectural features are captured through fine line work, creating an impression of texture. The scene suggests a quaint setting with elements of everyday life depicted in the drawing.

artworks.title: Penelope, A Doorway, Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching in green on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 10.9 × 6.9 cm (4 5/16 × 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a dark doorway. The individual is standing upright, with their head slightly bowed and hands holding an object at chest level. The facial features are softly depicted, and the hair is neat and appears to be pulled back. The clothing is a light gown or dress flowing down to the feet. The background is an artistic rendition of a doorway against a light-textured wall with sketched details and signatures, suggesting depth to the architectural setting. The artwork suggests an indoor or threshold setting with contrasts between dark and light.

artworks.title: Penelope, A Doorway, Chelsea
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 10.9 × 6.9 cm (4 5/16 × 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a person standing in profile within a doorway. The individual's head is slightly bowed, and they appear to be holding an object. They are wearing a long dress or robe, and their hair is pulled back. To the left, there are line drawings and scribbles, while the rest of the background is abstract with minimalistic lines, highlighting the doorway frame enclosing the figure.

artworks.title: Pierrot en Pied, Portrait of the Lady  A.C.
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 25.3 × 19 cm (9 15/16 × 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person standing upright. The individual has curly hair under a large, floppy hat. Their facial features are softly delineated, with a slightly tilted head. The person wears a vintage-style outfit with a high collar, decorative buttons, wide pants, and small, pointed shoes. The hands are relaxed by their sides, with one partially tucked into a pocket. The figure stands against a plain backdrop, emphasizing the simplicity of the etching.

artworks.title: Events over the Railings, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.5 × 11.8 cm (3 3/4 × 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people standing by a fence with blurred buildings in the background. The drawing features several figures standing in a casual grouping, with one figure sitting in a wheeled contraption. The figures are sketched with minimal detail, using light, rapid strokes. The background suggests an urban setting, with faint outlines of buildings and windows. The overall composition has a relaxed, everyday scene quality, capturing a moment of interaction or pause among the figures.

artworks.title: Chelsea Regatta
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 8.1 × 12 cm (3 3/16 × 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level scene with figures in the foreground. Near the bottom left, there are children with happy expressions. Moving towards the center, there are vertical lines resembling a fence or barrier. Above the barrier, there are what appear to be textiles or flags in a crowded area, perhaps suggestive of an outdoor market. The background shows tent-like structures and mast-like objects with a flag. The color scheme is mainly sepia and brown. The artist uses various crosshatched strokes for shading and texture in an etching style.

artworks.title: The Street, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 14.7 × 20.7 cm (5 13/16 × 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with storefronts and a horse-drawn cart. The image features a lively street corner with buildings adorned with signs. One sign reads “NEWS of the WORLD.” The architecture includes windows and awnings over the sidewalk. In front of the buildings, a horse is harnessed to a cart on the bustling street. Abstract, sketch-like human figures suggest movement and interaction. The upper portion of the drawing includes outlines of leaves and branches, contrasting the urban setting. The art's free-flowing lines and lack of rigid structure create a spontaneous and energetic quality.

artworks.title: The Pastoral Play
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 15.8 × 21.5 cm (6 1/4 × 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a natural scene. Two figures are in the foreground. The drawing consists of sketched lines and hatching creating texture and depth in an outdoor setting. The figures are outlined simply, with gestures suggesting interaction. The background features abstract foliage hints and sparse tree markings. The composition is minimalistic, using blank space and limited sketch work to convey the scene.

artworks.title: The Pastoral Play
artworks.medium: etching in green on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 15.7 × 21.5 cm (6 3/16 × 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pair of trees with two figures standing beneath them. Fine lines and subtle shading create a scene with intricate detailing on the foliage. The trees wrap around the central figures, creating a cocoon-like atmosphere. Each delicate stroke contributes to a sense of fluidity and grace, with the scene set against a light background. The drawing conveys an ethereal atmosphere, marked by its simplicity and refined artistry.

artworks.title: A French Girl
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 10.8 × 7.2 cm (4 1/4 × 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a person. The subject is in a straight-on position, facing the viewer. The person's facial features include large, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. Their hair is styled in a short, wavy fashion, neatly framing the face. They are wearing clothing with a light collar. There are no visible jewelry. The background is plain and textured, with no additional elements. There is a signature at the lower left of the drawing.

artworks.title: Jeanette, June 1887 / Flower
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint [cancelled plate] on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 8.9 × 6.3 cm (3 1/2 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows curved lines and shapes swirling in an abstract manner across a textured background. The forms resemble outlines of leaves or petals, alluding to elements of nature. The composition is minimalistic and elegant. Additional abstract markings or symbols are visible in the upper right corner, adding a sense of mystery and depth to the image.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and  gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people, with a kneeling figure in the foreground reaching out to a group of individuals standing beside and above them. One man among the standing group has a halo around his head, a long beard, and wavy hair. The figures are dressed in long robes, with the kneeling individual also wearing a mantle and a pouch hanging from their belt. In the background, more figures are walking along a curving path through a landscape with trees, houses, and a church-like structure. The sky is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: Christ Healing the Lame [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and  gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a congregation gathered around a lectern in an architectural setting. The drawing depicts a central figure standing at a lectern, apparently addressing an assembly. The figure is barefoot and has a halo iconograph. The scene is set within an architectural environment with arches and columns. The figures display varied poses and gestures, suggesting engrossed attention or lively discourse. The use of shading and intricate lines adds texture and detail to the garments and faces of the figures, enhancing the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Three Oaks
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a natural landscape scene. The viewpoint provides an even perspective across the scene, displaying various details. The image shows a dense canopy tree in the center surrounded by smaller trees and shrubs. Fine lines illustrate the texture of bark, leaves, and grass. A fallen branch or log lies on the ground among long grass. In the background, a body of water reflects the surrounding flora. The sky has horizontal lines and wispy clouds, with a small bird in flight. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white for contrast and depth.

artworks.title: The Little Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows an old, rustic structure on the left side of the scene. Detailed lines depict foliage and the aged building, dominating the imagery. The style features intricate line work emphasizing texture and detail in the weathered wood and trees. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of brown and sepia, contributing to a vintage appearance. A figure with a small dog walks across a wooden bridge in the background. Birds are seen flying sparsely in the sky.

artworks.title: Grain Field at the Edge of a Wood (Corn Field)
artworks.description: The image is a ground-level view looking slightly upwards towards a horizon with a row of trees extending to the left. The trees are highly detailed. In the foreground, there are textured grasses leading to a fallen log. Further back, the land rises with denser clusters of trees. The overall color palette is monochrome with subtle variations of black and white. The sky is clear with fine lines and wispy clouds.

artworks.title: A Forest Marsh with Travelers on a Bank (The Travelers)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed landscape showing a serene water body. There is a large tree with gnarled roots and a twisted trunk leaning slightly to the left, casting shadows on the water. In the background, there is a horizon of distant trees, and the sky has wispy clouds. The artwork is rendered in fine, precise brushstrokes or etching technique, creating a rich texture. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Cottage on a Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated view. There is a horizon with hills or mountains visible in the distance. Some structures are faintly seen on the horizon. The painting features intricate brushstrokes, depicting dense foliage with fine lines and hatch marks. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white. A large tree with widespread branches is prominent in the foreground. The landscape includes rolling terrain with trees and buildings indicating a small village. The sky has large, detailed clouds.

artworks.title: Woodland Scene
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape in a rich etching style with intricate details. A town with buildings and a cathedral-like structure is seen in the distance. The sky above has swirling clouds and birds in flight. Large trees are on the right with detailed foliage. A rocky path winds through the scene, leading to a wooden bridge where figures are walking. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. In the distance, there are gently rolling hills.

artworks.title: Draughtsman on a Stone before a Bridge
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from a slightly elevated point of view, revealing a dramatic cliffside scene. Dense foliage of tall trees, jagged rocks, and woodlands extend across the image. A rustic wooden bridge made of rough-hewn logs spans the image diagonally from left to right. There is a seated figure on a rocky outcrop close to us. Structures and trees are perched on rocky formations in the distance. The line work is intricate, capturing fine details of the trees and rocks. The color palette is monochrome with shades of grey. Soft clouds can be seen in the distant background, blending into the sky, tree-line, and cliffs.

artworks.title: Woodland Scene with a Waterfall
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a descending path on the left where two figures walk with a dog. Rocky terrain and trees frame the scene, leading towards a distant town on the horizon with a bridge, buildings, and ships at a port. The cityscape is set against the skyline, with fine lines and meticulous etching capturing natural and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey and black defining form and texture. The sky has dynamic cloud formations.
